text: Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613914. Select canonical_smiles, molecule chembl_id, and standard_value. Source from compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, activities, and assays tables. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, and activities to assays on assay_id. Filter by assays.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1613914' and activities.standard_relation equals '='. Sort by standard_value ascending. Limit to 10 rows.
